messages:
matt: Quick heads-up — canary to 10% for the new batcher heuristic is showing p95 regressions on /api/v1/chat/generate (high-tier). p95 from ~120ms -> ~210ms. :thinking:
maria: Can you paste the profiling snapshot?
matt: Putting the key numbers below:
```
route: /chat/generate
p95: 210ms (canary) vs 120ms (baseline)
kernel_switches/s: 48 -> 132
kv_hit_rate: 0.92 -> 0.64
avg_batch_size: 6.2 -> 8.9
tokens_budget_target: route_tier_high=18 -> 11
```
alex: Tokens budget dropped — the nudger lowered per-request targets to favor throughput, right? That can increase batching but hurt KV locality.
maria: Yep, dynamic-budger_v2 applied the symmetry rule to aggressive routes. It reduced the per-request budget for high-tier to squeeze more microbatching.
priya: We saw similar behavior in staging but on smaller models. For Llama-70B the kernel selection flips to quant-int8 paths and prefetch doesn't trigger, increasing kernel switches and misses.
matt: Proposal: partial rollback of the symmetry rule for high-tier routes and pin target_tokens=16 for /chat/generate. Also bump KV prefetch window from 64 -> 128 on canary nodes.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 3419876500 applied dynamic-budger_v2 to pool:canary-3
alex: Canary started at 3419876500. If we rollback we need patch + canary update.
maria: Quick patch config snippet below — small override scoped to the route so we don't undo global improvements:
```yaml
dynamic_budget:
  route_overrides:
    "/chat/generate":
      target_tokens: 16
  prefetch:
    kv_window: 128
  kernel_prefetch_hysteresis: 0.12
```
matt: Running perf-runner on canary nodes now to validate KV hit and p95. Will post results in ~10m. :eyes:
priya: Also add an alert: kernel_switches > 100/min for pool:canary-3 so we catch regressions early.
alex: SGTM. Ops standby for rollback if no improvement.
matt: perf-runner snapshot after patch:
```
kv_hit_rate: 0.87
p95: 132ms
kernel_switches/s: 62
avg_batch_size: 7.0
```
maria: Much better. Keep the canary at 10% for 1h and then ramp to 30% if stable. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary updated 3419876800 with route override applied
matt: Filing this into perf board as INF-4521 with traces and flamegraphs attached. Thanks all.
